name: themes
description: Settings → Color theme (docs/color-themes.md). The free app: Classic is checked and the Pro themes show locked, with their 'Pro theme, locked' names (never tapped: that opens Google Play). CalcCraft Pro (and the open-source build): Night can be picked, the calculator still reads its display under it, and Gold, Pro's default, is picked back.

steps.scroll_to: Gold, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
Night, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
Paper, Pro theme, locked, opens CalcCraft Pro on Google Play
